```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr:
        description: 'Pull request number to review'
        required: false
        type: string
      repo:
        description: 'Repository name (unused)'
        required: false
        type: string
      gitref:
        description: 'Git reference (unused)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Validate PR input
        id: validate-pr
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ inputs.pr }}" ]; then
            echo "pr_missing=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "pr_missing=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post error comment
        if: steps.validate-pr.outputs.pr_missing == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            ❌ **Error**: Pull request number is missing. Please provide a PR number.

      - name: Checkout PR branch
        if: steps.validate-pr.outputs.pr_missing == 'false'
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Detect changed files
        if: steps.validate-pr.outputs.pr_missing == 'false'
        id: detect-files
        env:
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR: ${{ inputs.pr }}
        run: |
          gh api --paginate "repos/${REPO}/pulls/${PR}/files" -q '.[].filename' > files.txt
          if grep -qE 'docs/' files.txt; then
            echo "docs_changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "docs_changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post start comment
        if: steps.detect-files.outputs.docs_changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            🚀 **AI Docs Review**: Starting review of documentation changes...

      - name: Post skip comment
        if: steps.detect-files.outputs.docs_changed == 'false'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            ⚠️ **AI Docs Review**: No documentation changes detected. Skipping review.

      - name: Run Devin action
        if: steps.detect-files.outputs.docs_changed == 'true'
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@0d74d6d9ff1b16ada5966dc31af53a9d155759f4
        with:
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_TOKEN }}
```
